# Modeling Datasets

**Author:** M. El Aabaribaoune

## Purpose
Contains the final structured tabular ML-ready datasets used for model training, evaluation, and subsequent Explainable AI (XAI) analysis.

## Conventions
**Important:** Files in this directory are generated by project scripts. Do NOT manually modify generated Parquet products. Regenerate through the corresponding dataset builder scripts in `scripts/datasets/`.
